payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Based only on the saved observations and image-grounded evidence from both supports, was a frog added inside the toilet?
node.criteria: complete: both supports pass and their evidence establishes that the frog is visibly inside the toilet. partial: evidence establishes some progress toward the requested placement, such as a frog present but not clearly inside the toilet, or only partly placed there. absent: evidence establishes that no requested change has progressed, including a clearly absent frog; a present frog clearly outside the toilet is not fulfillment and is absent unless evidence establishes partial placement. unknown: necessary evidence about frog presence or placement remains unresolved, or the observations do not establish whether any requested progress occurred. A known negative observation is evidence, not unknown; unrelated edits do not count. Do not infer facts beyond the support evidence.
node.binding: The requested change is to put a frog inside the toilet. Combine both support observations and their evidence; do not treat either support fact alone as fulfillment.

outcome.description: Add a frog inside the toilet.

dependencies.evidence: The edited image visibly contains several bright green frogs, including one sitting inside the toilet bowl. The source image shows no frog.
The edited image visibly contains an identifiable toilet, including the bowl and tank.
